source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of input and output (PDF 36-37).

blocks.text: Input aur output operations se program user ke saath interact karta hai (baat cheet karta hai). Aap user se data likhwa sakte hain (input) aur user ko information (maloomat) dikha sakte hain (output).

items: Input: user se kuch lene ke liye input() function istemal karein. input() screen par message dikhata hai aur wait karta hai (intezar karta hai) ke user kuch type kar ke Enter dabaye. User ka likha text phir ek variable mein rakh liya jata hai. Misaal:

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"input("Enter your name: ")": screen par "Enter your name: " dikhata hai aur intezar karta hai ke user kuch type kar ke Enter dabaye.
"name = ...": user ne jo likha woh text (string) ban kar variable name mein rakh diya jata hai.
Yeh sirf ek line hai: is mein print nahi, is liye user ka naam wapas screen par nahi aata. Agli misaal ki print line isi name ko istemal karti hai.
Output: sirf sawal "Enter your name: " nazar aata hai; jawab likhne ke baad kuch aur print nahi hota.
Yeh line user se us ka naam poochhti hai aur usay variable name mein rakh deti hai.

items: Output: screen par information dikhane ke liye print() function istemal karein. print() ek ya zyada arguments (cheezein jo function ko di jati hain) leta hai aur unhein dikhata hai. Misaal:

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"print (...)": brackets ke andar ka text screen par dikhata hai.
"" As - Salaam - Alaikum , " + name + "!"": + nishan strings ko jor deta hai: pehle salaam wala text, phir name variable ki value, phir "!".
Yeh line akeli nahi chal sakti: name pichhli line (name = input(...)) mein banta hai. Akele chalane par NameError aata hai kyun ke name maujood nahi.
Output: dono lines saath hon aur user Ali likhe to " As - Salaam - Alaikum , Ali!" chhapta hai (shuru mein ek space aur dash ke dono taraf spaces, bilkul kitab ke text jaise).
Yeh line salaam ka message dikhati hai jis mein user ka naam shamil hota hai. Maslan user Ali likhe to output " As - Salaam - Alaikum , Ali!" hoga: + nishan strings ko jor deta hai.

blocks.prompt: age = 25; print("Age:", age) ka output kya hai (MCQ 4)?

blocks.text: Yahan input() ki jagah name aur age ki values seedhi likhi hain. Dono badal kar Run karein aur dekhein print() ka output kaise badalta hai.

name = "Ayesha"
age = 17
print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!")
print("Age:", age)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"name = "Ayesha"" aur "age = 17": input() ki jagah values seedhi likh di gayi hain taake program foran chal sake.
"print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, " + name + "!")": + se teen strings jurti hain: salaam, naam aur "!".
"print("Age:", age)": comma se text aur number dono print ho jate hain; beech mein space khud lagta hai. (+ se string aur number nahi jur sakte, comma se ho jata hai.)
Output: "As-Salaam-Alaikum, Ayesha!" aur "Age: 17".
Khud try karein: name = "Bilal" kar ke Run karein: pehli line "As-Salaam-Alaikum, Bilal!" ho jayegi.

items: input(): user se text le kar variable mein rakhta hai.
print(): screen par dikhata hai; + strings jorta hai.
